purpose: Create an original, identity-lockable Critic character for the EVAVO Council before any animation production begins.

views.label: full body slight right three-quarter
views.prompt: Eye-level full-body presentation, slight right three-quarter orientation, complete head, hands and shoes visible, relaxed natural hands, no dramatic perspective.

views.label: full body slight left three-quarter
views.prompt: Same exact person and clothing from a slight left three-quarter orientation, eye level, complete silhouette and both hands clearly readable.

views.label: neutral identity bust
views.prompt: Neutral chest-up identity view of the same exact person, calm direct gaze, no smile performance, face and hair details clear enough for continuity review.

style.lock: EVAVO-crafted editorial character design with premium creative-studio art direction. Original adult woman with a precise, formidable but not villain-coded presence. Short sculptural silver-black bob, sharply readable face, calm direct gaze, matte charcoal tailored coat with an asymmetric high collar over a simple black base layer, dark tailored trousers and grounded footwear. One restrained cherry-red construction detail such as a narrow seam or lapel insert. Realistic anatomy and fabric construction, clean readable silhouette, no generic AI-assistant or game-character look.
style.continuity: Every view in a candidate set must show the same exact person, facial structure, age, skin tone, hair cut and colour, coat construction, collar shape, proportions, handedness, footwear, cherry-red detail placement, baseline and overall material language. Do not redesign between views.
mustHave: complete adult human anatomy with natural hands and five stable fingers per visible hand
short sculptural silver-black bob with a consistent silhouette
matte charcoal asymmetric high-collar tailored coat
simple black base layer and dark tailored trousers
one restrained cherry-red seam or lapel construction detail
strong readable full-body silhouette distinct from EVA and Top Hat Man
genuine transparent background with no scene or floor plate
mustAvoid: holograms or floating user interface elements
robot parts, glowing eyes, headsets or futuristic armour
Top Hat Man Victorian hat, moustache or historical tailoring
weapons, tactical gear or superhero costume language
logos, readable text, watermark, scenery or checkerboard transparency
cropped head, hands, fingers, feet or clothing hem
style.originality: Create a new EVAVO-owned Critic identity from this art direction. Do not reconstruct, imitate or closely derive any protected fictional character, celebrity, stock mascot or existing AI-assistant character. The visual language should feel deliberately art-directed for EVAVO rather than recognisable as another product or franchise.
